scope: Disposable local integration candidate; no remote publication, production deployment, hosted credentials or live resources

passed: isolated selected-image backup/restore and exact receipt replay
exact image archive checksum and load verification

build.binding: Locally observed build from inventoried isolated source; all inventoried files verified unchanged after checks/build

checks.name: current Rust contract/storage/migration tests
checks.command: AQ_GRAPH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=<isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 loopback URL> CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 cargo test --locked --all-targets

checks.name: archived exact image load
checks.command: gzip -dc image.tar.gz | docker load; docker image inspect aq-graph:graph01-225329cd6acf-pinned --format {{.Id}}

checks.name: packaged artifact integrity and source replay
checks.command: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS; clone source.bundle into fresh disposable checkout; unpack source.tar.gz; verify every source file against source-inventory.json and exact candidate commit; packaged executable --help

api.readiness: Embedded migration versions and checksums must exactly match; old binary/new schema rollback not assumed

mutation.cas: Positive opaque expected_version/content_revision tokens; stale write returns 409 conflict, never overwrites
mutation.same_key_same_payload: Committed exact receipt/IDs replay after lost response or restart; object key order immaterial
mutation.timeouts: May occur after commit; retry original key and identical parsed payload
mutation.receipt_retention: Indefinite pilot retention; no automatic receipt/history pruning

principal.scope: One workspace and read/write/admin capability; supplied actor fields rejected; finer AQ attempt/task authorization remains AQ adapter responsibility
principal.provenance: Authenticated service principal is actor; task/session metadata is attribution, never another authorized actor
principal.credentials: 32-4096 bytes; hashes only in storage; issue/rotate/revoke via admin routes; last administrator cannot be removed
principal.rotation: Remove bootstrap environment before rotating initial admin; preserve stable actor identity for actor-scoped receipt reconciliation

compatibility.recovery: PostgreSQL 17.11 exact table count/content hashes, revisions/links/history/draft/summary/ready leaf and idempotent replay match after isolated backup/restore; selected image writes/restarts on restored clone
compatibility.platform: Selected image Linux amd64 with Debian bookworm runtime; optional native CLI built Ubuntu 24.04.4/WSL2 glibc 2.39

labels.org.opencontainers.image.description: Standalone task and knowledge graph service and CLI
labels.org.opencontainers.image.title: aq-graph

limits: Source candidate is committed graph HEAD; preexisting uncommitted docs/aq-integration.md changes excluded.
No production AQ adapters, execution claims, offline replicas or V1 import.
Standalone tests and recovery do not establish WAN/product capacity or production ingress/security/host recovery.
No old load benchmark was substituted for current qualification; performance envelope remains independently qualified.

Base image digests and pinned Dockerfile retained; Dockerfile still uses live apt repositories, so byte-for-byte rebuild reproducibility is not claimed. Exact selected image is archived, checksummed and reload-verified.
The unpinned initial image and digest-pinned rebuild have different image IDs; only the final pinned image is selected and its recovery was rerun.
Native CLI requires glibc 2.39; the selected container has its own Debian runtime. macOS/other platforms not rerun here.
No remote registry publication or production credential changes.
